annotations.axe: axe-core rule ids that correspond to the intended barrier
annotations.htmlcs: HTML_CodeSniffer codes (full pa11y code, exact match); optional types restricts which issue types count
annotations.linkedPage: the barrier is on this linked example page; the retest harness tests it as well (scripts/retest/run.mjs) and the classifier merges its evidence
annotations.linkedPages: the barrier is on these linked example pages; the harness tests each and the classifier merges their evidence
annotations.review: "pending" = borderline choice awaiting human review (D-011 style)
